note: Tab audio is the interviewer. Mic audio is the candidate. Times are seconds from the start of the video.

events.text: I am doing well, thank you.
Ashish, can you tell me about yourself?
I have been learning security operations and I watch the alert queue.
Why did you choose cybersecurity as your career?
I chose it because I like the investigative work and I stayed with it.
What are the roles and responsibilities of a security analyst?
I triage the alerts and I escalate what I cannot close.
What reports do you prepare as SOC L1?
I write the daily alert report and I send the escalation summary.
What do you know about routing?
I know a router forwards packets and I have read the routing table.
